requirement: The getting-started documentation MUST explain that the session-start hook tells the agent to load the `habeas` skill.
rationale:
The subject has one obligation. The getting-started documentation must explain that the session-start hook tells the agent to load the `habeas` skill. Two tests in `tests/repository.rs` carry a {test} reference to it. They are `getting_started_documents_symposium_setup_and_skill_migration` and `installation_guides_cover_setup_hooks_refresh_and_preserving_local_skills`. I did not read the `repository_file` helper. I assumed it returns the file text.

- **`getting_started_documents_symposium_setup_and_skill_migration`:** It runs for both `README.md` and `md/getting_started.md`. It asserts the text contains "session", "hook" and "`habeas` skill". It then asserts that a single paragraph contains "hook tells", "load the `habeas` skill before starting any work" and "session". That ties the hook, the session start and the skill-loading instruction together in one explanation. A document that only mentions the words in unrelated places would fail.
- **`installation_guides_cover_setup_hooks_refresh_and_preserving_local_skills`:** It checks "load the `habeas` skill" in both files. It also checks the exact sentences. In the README, "Its session-start hook tells the agent that the project tracks requirements with Habeas and to load the `habeas` skill before starting any work." In `md/getting_started.md`, "When an agent starts a session in this project, Habeas's hook tells it that the project tracks requirements with Habeas and to load the `habeas` skill before starting any work."

Together the tests enforce that the hook, its session-start trigger and the instruction to load the `habeas` skill are explained in the getting-started guide. They would fail if that explanation were removed or reworded away from its subject.

The setup-advice, sync and local-edits assertions belong to the parent requirement `requirements.install.symposium`, not to this one. I found no gap and no unacknowledged obligation.
